RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel can signal potential unconscious bias, but on its own, it does not prove discrimination. Head-of-laboratory positions often prioritize formal management qualifications and broad organizational leadership over academic credentials like a PhD, which may explain the decision. 

Directly alleging sex discrimination now is premature and could harm professional relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback and interview scoring rubric. Additionally, check whether institutional hiring guidelines mandate diverse interview panels. If the eventual feedback reveals clear procedural irregularities, double standards, or a failure to apply objective criteria, you will have concrete grounds to raise concerns through HR or an employment advisor.
